name: Icons
description: All icons share IconProps. Import only the named icons your interface uses; meaningful icons need a label, decorative icons omit it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Omit for decorative icons (the default) — they are hidden from AT.

props.name: size
props.description: Token size. Omit only when a parent component sizes its icons.

props.name: tint
props.description: Set false to drop the duotone tint for this instance.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.
